nodes.description: Public mapping address=>uint256 tracking per-user deposits; written in Deposit and decremented in Collect after an external call.
Public uint minimum withdrawal threshold, initialized to 1 ether and set via SetMinSum.
External LogFile contract reference used by Deposit and Collect to record messages.
Bool initialization guard; once set to true it locks SetMinSum and SetLogFile.
Public one-time setter for MinSum, guarded by the intitalized flag.
Public one-time setter for the external Log contract address, guarded by intitalized.
Public function that irreversibly sets intitalized to true, locking the setters.
Public payable function that credits msg.value to balances[msg.sender] and logs the deposit.
Public payable withdrawal function that performs msg.sender.call.value(_am)() before decreasing the caller balance, enabling reentrancy.
Public payable fallback that forwards any plain value transfer into Deposit.
Public LogFile function that writes sender, timestamp, value and data into LastMsg and pushes it to History.
Public array of Message structs holding the append-only log of all recorded messages.
Message struct storing the most recent log entry before it is pushed to History.
Caller-controlled address used as the balances key, the withdrawal beneficiary and the log sender.
Low-level external value call to an attacker-controlled address executed before the balance is decremented.
Input _val assigned directly to the MinSum state variable.
Input _log address cast to LogFile and assigned to the Log state variable.
Withdrawal amount _am compared against the caller balance and forwarded as call value.
Address _adr written into LastMsg.Sender.
Value _val written into LastMsg.Val.
String _data written into LastMsg.Data.
Block timestamp (now) stored into LastMsg.Time when a message is added.

edges.reason: Parameter _val is consumed by SetMinSum to update the MinSum threshold.
SetMinSum writes the caller-supplied value into the MinSum state variable.
Parameter _log is cast to LogFile inside SetLogFile.
SetLogFile stores the supplied address into the Log state variable.
SetMinSum reads the intitalized flag and reverts when it is already true.
SetLogFile reads the intitalized flag and reverts when it is already true.
Initialized permanently sets the intitalized guard to true.
msg.sender is the account whose balance is credited by Deposit.
Deposit increments balances[msg.sender] by msg.value.
Deposit calls Log.AddMessage on the external LogFile contract.
The payable fallback forwards plain transfers into Deposit.
Collect uses the caller-controlled msg.sender both as the balance key and as the external call target.
Collect reads MinSum to check the minimum withdrawal threshold.
Collect reads balances[msg.sender] to validate the amount before the balance is reduced.
The _am argument bounds the withdrawal amount checked in Collect.
Collect reaches the external call msg.sender.call.value(_am)() inside the validation branch.
The user-supplied _am is forwarded as the value of the external call.
The low-level call lets the attacker's contract re-enter via the payable fallback.
balances[msg.sender] is decremented only after the external call returns, so a re-entrant path can double-withdraw.
AddMessage writes parameter _adr into the LastMsg struct.
AddMessage writes parameter _val into the LastMsg struct.
AddMessage writes parameter _data into the LastMsg struct.
AddMessage stores the block timestamp (now) into LastMsg.Time, creating a timestamp dependency in the log record.
AddMessage populates the LastMsg state struct.
AddMessage pushes LastMsg onto the History array.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _val is only used to set MinSum inside SetMinSum and has no independent role.
Parameter _log is only used to assign the Log reference inside SetLogFile.
Parameter _am is only meaningful for the Collect withdrawal logic and external call value.
Parameter _adr is consumed solely by AddMessage when filling LastMsg.Sender.
Parameter _val is consumed solely by AddMessage when filling LastMsg.Val.
Parameter _data is consumed solely by AddMessage when filling LastMsg.Data.
